note: Archetypes are recommendations, not restrictions: each gives starting bonus points over the baseline (spent from the build's budget), the positions it suits, and a description. A hybrid is any build whose attributes you choose yourself; 'custom' is the empty template. The bonus points of every archetype must fit build_rules.json budget_points (a test checks it).

archetypes.name: Custom
archetypes.description: Start from the baseline and spend every point yourself.
